dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About what's happening up on the snowy mountain...

dialogues.speaker: Nekrasov
dialogues.text: Ah, you mean the rumors? You must be asking about the mansion up on the mountain. But it's not a rumor... it's actually out there.

dialogues.speaker: Nekrasov
dialogues.text: It belongs to Pavlina, the Snegurochka princess of the Snegoviks.... Though she rarely ventures out, she does occasionally invite humans to the manor as her guests.

dialogues.speaker: Nekrasov
dialogues.text: Mind you... word is that none of those guests ever make it back down.
